name: Mega Escape: Squid Game 3 season
desc:
Do you enjoy awesome cutscenes and story, obby and parkour, or beating monsters and bosses? Then this game is for you.
This is a story about you being dragged into a Squid Game. It does not proceed fairly, rules and safety are disregarded. Face monsters, war machines, rising lava and other hazards. Survive and win despite all odds.

Latest Update July 2025
Added some new parkour sections and a new boss fight.

This game features:
- Engaging parkour and puzzles
- Interactions - switches, levers, buttons and pushable objects
- Map of the game which you can use to teleport. Saves progress!
- Numerous enemies - ranged, jumping and even self-exploding
- Several types of weapons
- Upgrades
- Epic boss fights
- Awesome cutscenes
